entities.title: Fail the side-by-side check when a library has not marked a task
entities.summary: Every library must mark every task, but side_by_side.py renders a missing task as a Missing section instead of failing.
entities.compromise: render collects the missing language:task pairs and appends them to the page; --check only compares the page with what render produces.
entities.cost: A library can drop a task marker, the page can be regenerated with a Missing section, and CI passes; the requirement that every library marks every task is not checked by anything.
acceptanceCriteria: python3 tools/side_by_side.py --check fails, naming the language and the task, when any of the five libraries has not marked one of the tasks in SECTIONS.

origin.description: The missing list in render, against docs/library-api.md §7: "Every library marks every task".
